column2: Each disciple of the painter spent years learning his master's brush techniques.
column3: 這位畫家的每個門徒都花了好幾年學習師父的筆法。
column5: disciple 像 discipline，跟著老師守紀律學習的人

column2: Her essay earned a distinction because it was so much clearer than the others.
column3: 她的文章因為比其他人的清楚許多，而獲得優等榮譽。
column4: graduate with distinction (以優異成績畢業)
column5: dis 分開 + stinct 刺：用針刺出記號，把你和別人分開

column2: A small package was left on the doorstep while we were out shopping.
column3: 我們外出購物時，有個小包裹被放在門階上。
column5: door 門 + step 台階，就是進門前踩的那一階

column2: Grandma kneaded the dough and left it to rise before baking the bread.
column3: 奶奶揉好麵糰，讓它發酵後再烤成麵包。
column5: dough 跟 though 同音，把麵粉想成軟軟的「豆」糰

column2: She keeps her sweaters folded neatly in the top drawer of the dresser.
column3: 她把毛衣整齊折好，放在衣櫃最上面的抽屜裡。
column5: dress 衣服 + er：放衣服的櫃子

column2: Dad poured olive oil dressing over the salad just before we sat down.
column3: 爸爸在我們入座前，把橄欖油醬汁淋在沙拉上。
column5: 給沙拉「穿上衣服」dress，就是淋上醬汁

column2: He parked the bike at the end of the driveway so the car could pass.
column3: 他把腳踏車停在車道盡頭，好讓汽車通過。
column4: park in the driveway (停在車道上)
column5: drive 開車 + way 路：開進家門的那條路

column2: The duration of the film is almost three hours, so bring some snacks.
column3: 這部電影長達將近三小時，所以要帶點零食。
column5: du 同 during「期間」，ration 像 -tion：持續的時間長度

column2: The old stone dwelling by the river had no electricity or running water.
column3: 河邊那間老石屋沒有電，也沒有自來水。
column5: dwell 居住 + ing：人居住的地方

column2: An eel slipped through the net and vanished into the muddy water.
column3: 一條鰻魚從網中溜走，消失在混濁的水裡。
column5: eel 像「已」：滑溜溜細長細長，像個倒下的 e

column2: Enrollment at our school rose to nine hundred students this autumn.
column3: 今年秋天我們學校的註冊人數增加到九百名學生。
column5: en 放進 + roll 名冊：把名字放進名冊

column2: The family sold their country estate and moved into a small city apartment.
column3: 這家人賣掉鄉下的莊園，搬進市區的小公寓。
column5: real estate 就是不動產，土地房子都算 estate

column2: Our coach teaches that a strong work ethic matters more than natural talent.
column3: 教練教導我們，認真的工作倫理比天分更重要。
column5: ethic 諧音「一thick」：品德厚厚的才是倫理

column2: Saying you waited forever for a ten-minute delay is a harmless exaggeration.
column3: 把十分鐘的延誤說成等了一輩子，是無傷大雅的誇張。
column5: exaggerate 的名詞，把小事講得比天大

column2: The shop sells soft cotton fabric in many bright colors for school projects.
column3: 這家店販售各種鮮豔顏色的柔軟棉布，適合學校的手作專題。
column5: fabric 諧音「發不力」：布料一發就讓人用力縫

column2: Hula hoops were a fad in the fifties, but most kids soon lost interest.
column3: 呼拉圈在五○年代風行一時，但大多數孩子很快就失去興趣。
column5: fad 諧音「發的」：發得快、退得也快的流行

column2: He proudly introduced his fiancée to the whole family at the dinner table.
column3: 他在餐桌上驕傲地向全家人介紹他的未婚妻。
column5: fiancée 諧音「肥翁塞」：快結婚的女生被塞進家族照

column2: Eating more fiber from vegetables and beans helps your stomach work well.
column3: 多吃蔬菜和豆類中的纖維，有助於腸胃運作良好。
column5: fiber 諧音「發bar」：吃了發出能量棒的纖維

column2: The shark's tall fin cut through the surface as it circled the boat.
column3: 鯊魚高高的背鰭劃破水面，繞著船打轉。
column5: fin 像 fish 的短版，魚的小翅膀

column2: After a year in Canada, her fluency in English impressed every teacher.
column3: 在加拿大待了一年後，她流利的英語讓每位老師都印象深刻。
column5: flu 像 flow 流：話像水一樣流出來

column2: In the old tale, the knight forgave his foe instead of seeking revenge.
column3: 在古老的故事中，騎士原諒了他的敵人，而不是尋求報復。
column5: foe 諧音「佛」：遇到敵人念佛，與 friend 對比

column2: Wrap the leftover fish in foil before you put it in the oven.
column3: 把剩下的魚用鋁箔紙包好，再放進烤箱。
column5: foil 諧音「佛要」：佛要用金箔，金屬薄片就是箔

column2: Farmers keep ducks, geese, and other fowl in the yard behind the barn.
column3: 農夫在穀倉後面的院子裡養鴨、鵝和其他家禽。
column5: fowl 跟 owl 貓頭鷹只差 f，都是鳥類

column2: Only a fraction of the class finished the long quiz before the bell rang.
column3: 只有一小部分學生在鐘響前寫完那份很長的小考。
column5: fract 打破：打破後的一小片，也是分數 fraction

column2: The new law sets a framework for how cities must plan their parks.
column3: 這項新法律為各城市規劃公園的方式訂出了架構。
column5: frame 框 + work 作品：先有框，才能把內容填進去

column2: Early settlers pushed west toward the frontier in covered wagons.
column3: 早期移民乘著篷車向西前進，朝邊疆而去。
column5: front 前面 + ier：站在最前面的邊界

column2: The crowd listened in fury as the unfair decision was announced.
column3: 當不公平的決定宣布時，群眾怒氣沖沖地聆聽。
column5: fury 諧音「夫瑞」：夫瑞氣到臉紅發燙

column2: She hung each garment carefully in the closet to keep it from wrinkling.
column3: 她小心地把每件衣服掛進衣櫥，以免起皺。
column5: garment 諧音「剛門」：剛出門穿的那件衣服

column2: A small gathering of neighbors formed outside the school after the fire drill.
column3: 消防演習後，一小群鄰居聚集在學校外面。
column5: gather 聚集 + ing：人們聚在一起的場合

column2: In geometry class, we learned how to measure the angles of a triangle.
column3: 在幾何課上，我們學會如何測量三角形的角度。
column5: geo 土地 + metry 測量：古代用來量土地的學問

column2: The children shouted with glee when they saw the snow covering the playground.
column3: 孩子們看到雪覆蓋了操場，歡欣地大叫。
column5: glee 諧音「葛立」：笑到「個哩」個哩的開心

column2: The choir sang a gospel song that made everyone in the hall clap along.
column3: 合唱團唱了一首福音歌曲，讓大廳裡的每個人都跟著拍手。
column5: god 神 + spell 話：神的話語就是福音

column2: The king's greed made him raise taxes until his people could barely eat.
column3: 國王的貪心讓他不斷加稅，直到人民幾乎吃不飽。
column4: greed for money (對金錢的貪婪)
column5: greed 諧音「革理的」：什麼都想要，貪心沒完沒了

column2: Wandering from town to town, the gypsy sold handmade baskets at the market.
column3: 那名流浪者從一個城鎮走到另一個城鎮，在市場賣手編的籃子。
column4: a wandering gypsy (流浪的吉普賽人)
column5: gypsy 諧音「吉普西」：坐吉普車四處走走停停的人

column2: Her new hairdo looked fancy, but it took an hour to style each morning.
column3: 她的新髮型看起來很時髦，但每天早上要花一小時整理。
column5: hair 頭髮 + do 做：頭髮做出來的造型

column2: The village market is famous for handicraft such as woven mats and bamboo baskets.
column3: 這個村落的市集以編織蓆和竹籃等手工藝品聞名。
column5: hand 手 + i + craft 工藝：用雙手做出的工藝

column2: When the old king died without a son, his niece became the heir.
column3: 老國王沒有兒子就過世了，他的姪女成了繼承人。
column4: heir to the throne (王位繼承人)
column5: heir 的 h 不發音，跟 air 同音，錢像空氣降到你頭上

column2: Mom grows mint and basil, two herbs that make her soup taste fresh.
column3: 媽媽種了薄荷和羅勒這兩種香草，讓她煮的湯嘗起來很清新。
column5: herb 美式 h 不發音，唸起來像「噁」，香草味道獨特

column2: The hermit lived alone in a mountain cave and rarely met other people.
column3: 那位隱士獨自住在山洞裡，很少見到別人。
column4: live like a hermit (過著隱士般的生活)
column5: hermit 諧音「喝蜜」：一個人在山上默默喝蜂蜜

column2: Dad saved up for months to buy a hi-fi system for the living room.
column3: 爸爸存了好幾個月的錢，為客廳買了一套高傳真音響。
column5: hi 高 + fi 傳真：聲音很高水準地還原
